captions.detailed: A detached stone belfry tower featuring a tall, cylindrical gray shaft and an upper tier with open, round-arched windows. A dark conical roof tops the structure, complete with a small finial. Inside the belfry, a cast-bronze bell is mounted on a wooden yoke that swings on a horizontal revolute joint, with a secondary clapper rod suspended inside on an independent revolute pin.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a round stone belfry tower. It must feature a cylindrical stone shaft, an upper arcade tier with open round-arch windows, a dark conical roof, and an internal cast-bronze bell on a wooden yoke that rotates via a horizontal revolute joint, complete with an independently swinging clapper rod.
captions.factory: Construct the main tower shaft using a tall cylinder primitive. Model the upper belfry tier by combining vertical support columns and segmented arched blocks arranged radially. Create the conical roof using a cone or revolved profile with a small top cylinder for the finial. Model the bell using a revolved bell shape, the yoke as a horizontal box beam, and the clapper as a slender cylinder with a sphere at the end. Establish a revolute joint between the belfry frame and the yoke, and a secondary revolute joint between the yoke and the clapper.
